design.principle: A KEPT holding is a holding the provider could not confirm and yfinance can price. Steps (1) and (2) run inside the resident, in the resolver, before the finding is made; the door writes nothing.

step_1_known.where: SecurityResolver.check, security_resolution.py:204-212: the identity port (currently the None stub at resident_worker.py:619-620) is wired to a read-only lookup of etf-classifications by ticker and of MDPF_SECHIST's per-security index by ticker or CUSIP. A registry hit is evidence (reference), not FOUND, exactly as the file's own comment requires (security_resolution.py:204).
step_1_known.order: provider read first (as today); for each symbol the provider answers NOT_FOUND, the registry check runs; a known symbol with no provider row is KNOWN, and step 2 is skipped for it.

step_2_yfinance_check.where: the same resolver, after step 1, for NOT_FOUND symbols only (never for FOUND or the entitlement/fund-unverified reasons).
step_2_yfinance_check.call: yf.Ticker(symbol).history(period='1mo', auto_adjust=False) -- the same read measured in section measurement. Rows > 0 and a last close that is finite and positive -> KEPT. Zero rows -> NOT_FOUND unchanged.
step_2_yfinance_check.error_discrimination: yfinance hides exceptions by default and returns an empty frame (measured: ALPPL, BREIT and CCCQ each returned 0 rows with no exception; ALPPL printed 'HTTP Error 404 ... Quote not found'). The checker must set yf.config.debug.hide_exceptions = False (or the raise_errors argument, deprecated in yfinance 1.2.0) so that an outage raises and is NOT read as absence.
step_2_yfinance_check.pacing: one history call per unknown symbol, sequential. Proposed bounds for CTO ruling: a gap of 8 to 12 s (the yahoo_pull.py Pacer rule, data/mdpf/scripts/demque/yahoo_pull.py:141-144) is too slow for an interactive upload with many unknowns, so the design needs a per-upload cap K (the CTO sets K) and the rest stay NOT_FOUND with the finding unchanged. A 401, 403 or 429 stops the step for the rest of the upload (yahoo_pull.py:33 _PUSHBACK_CODES).
step_2_yfinance_check.egress_gate: Yahoo from the resident is NOT admitted by the grant as read (MDPF_SECHIST PRD ADDENDUM v0.2, lines 168-171). It needs Andrew's word before any build. Surfaced, not assumed (see surprise IRPT_ANLREQ-D2-W99-S5).

kept_holding_to_the_rest_of_the_upload.shape: a new resolver state (for example KEPT, never FOUND), with reason EXACT_YFINANCE_HISTORY_KEEP and a receipt carrying source yfinance, the as-of date of the last close and the row count. portfolio.py:464-471 (the FOUND gate) is unchanged, so a KEPT row does not pass as FOUND; a new branch beside it in freeze_template_portfolio carries the KEPT row into the holdings.
kept_holding_to_the_rest_of_the_upload.pricing: USD basis: no price needed; the dollars stand. SHARES basis: price from MDPF_SECHIST's series when it has one (not composed in the resident today: uploads.py:592 resolve_prices, resident_upload_service sets SHARES_PRICE_SOURCE_NOT_COMPOSED), else the yfinance last close for THIS request only. Nothing is landed.
kept_holding_to_the_rest_of_the_upload.why_not_land_here: The registry row is MDPF_SECCLASS's table (C-TABLE: this project never writes classification; the only writer is the seed run from source). The price series is MDPF_SECHIST's CUSIP-keyed writer, switched off, and a ticker key is refused (security_series_writer.py:48-52). So for this request the price comes from the read, and the registry row and the series are other projects' writes that need their own pair.
